_metadata.description: Oracle OCI customer case studies with quantified outcomes for POC pattern matching
notes: Case studies sourced from official Oracle customer pages and verified announcements.
Metrics are as published by Oracle / the customer; use for directional SA guidance only.
Use case types map to Archie POC pattern categories.

case_studies.company: CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) / Linux Foundation Education

quantified_outcomes.cost_savings_percent: 50%+ on hosting costs for hands-on labs

case_studies.summary: CNCF migrated cloud-native project infrastructure and Linux Foundation Education hands-on training lab environments to OCI. Achieved $1M annual savings and planned 50%+ reduction in hosting costs for the full suite of training labs and exams.

quantified_outcomes.time_savings: Reduced overhead with Oracle Managed Services

case_studies.summary: MulticoreWare deployed their HuBe.ai AI video compression application on OCI, saving 75% in annual TCO vs. prior cloud provider. Used GPU compute for AI inference workloads.

case_studies.migration_from: Other cloud Kubernetes (AWS EKS / Azure AKS)
case_studies.summary: Tryg Insurance reduced Kubernetes cloud costs by 50% by implementing dynamic right-sizing on OKE with OCI Flex shapes. Eliminated over-provisioning through granular CPU/memory allocation.

quantified_outcomes.performance: Improved business continuity via multi-AD deployment

case_studies.summary: Zimperium migrated mobile threat defense platform to OKE, enabling multi-AD deployment for business continuity. Flex shapes allowed customized provisioning per application, achieving 15% cost savings.

case_studies.use_case_type: Data platform migration / Smart Data Platform
case_studies.summary: ChainSys deployed their Smart Data Platform (data migration, ETL, catalog, analytics) on OCI. Achieved 50% annual TCO savings, 30% performance improvement, and 15-20 hours/month time savings.

quantified_outcomes.performance: Scalable to large demand spikes; improved resilience
quantified_outcomes.time_savings: Deployed within 75 days without disrupting inventory management systems
quantified_outcomes.labor_cost_reduction: Helps customers reduce labor costs by 40%

case_studies.summary: Impulse Logic modernized SLiQ from monolithic to cloud-native on OKE with ATP. Their predictive analytics platform helps retailers reduce labor costs by 40%. Deployment takes 75 days with zero disruption to existing systems.

quantified_outcomes.performance: Eliminated complex multi-database architecture; fewer components
quantified_outcomes.other: Overcame project complexity; improved performance with Autonomous Database

case_studies.summary: DPA migrated from complex multi-database on-premises architecture to Oracle Autonomous Database. Eliminated need for MongoDB + relational hybrid via ADB's document store API support, simplifying architecture significantly.
Broctagon migrated AXIS FX Broker CRM from AWS EC2 + Aurora MySQL to OCI MySQL HeatWave. Achieved 30% performance improvement and 35% cost reduction as client base and data volumes scaled.

quantified_outcomes.performance: 4x faster time-to-market for instant loan application
quantified_outcomes.time_savings: 25% reduction in data preparation time for Lines of Business

case_studies.summary: Credify used MySQL HeatWave to accelerate their instant loan product 4x faster to market. Reduced costs by 60%+ and cut data preparation time for business users by 25%.

quantified_outcomes.performance: New server configuration active within 5 minutes vs 48-hour downtime on AWS
quantified_outcomes.time_savings: Eliminated 48-hour downtime windows for IP address changes

case_studies.summary: Noorisys migrated from AWS EC2 to MySQL HeatWave. Cost dropped to approximately half of AWS pricing with predictable fixed costs. Operational agility improved dramatically — new configs active in 5 minutes vs 48-hour downtime on AWS.

case_studies.use_case_type: AI/ML platform migration / Hyperscale voice AI

quantified_outcomes.performance: 50-60% performance boost vs previous cloud environment

case_studies.summary: SoundHound migrated voice AI platform to OCI for higher performance, built-in security, and lower cost. Achieved 50-60% performance improvement and 2x cost reduction. Platform now processes 100M+ queries/month supporting explosive growth.

quantified_outcomes.performance: 300% performance improvement after migrating to OCI
quantified_outcomes.scale: Billions of electronic tolling transactions per year, millions of accounts

case_studies.summary: ETC, a US intelligent transport systems provider, migrated to OCI and achieved 300% performance improvement. OCI now handles billions of tolling transactions annually with Oracle Analytics and AI/ML for predictive analytics and dashboards.

quantified_outcomes.performance: High-performance e-government services with dynamic scalability
quantified_outcomes.availability: Improved availability and fast disaster recovery
quantified_outcomes.other: Reduced operational overhead; faster product launch velocity

case_studies.summary: Takamol deployed four core e-government applications on OCI with OKE, improving availability, reducing operational tasks, and enabling faster disaster recovery. Used Kubernetes with Prometheus/Grafana observability stack.

quantified_outcomes.performance: Planned 10,000-GPU deployment on OCI; test bed demonstrated performance
quantified_outcomes.other: Selected OCI for proven performance in HPC/AI workloads

case_studies.summary: Argonne National Laboratory selected OCI for GPU workloads, with an initial cluster serving as test bed for a planned 10,000-GPU deployment. OCI selected for proven HPC/AI performance and RDMA networking capabilities.

case_studies.company: Generic: Oracle Database Standard Edition to ADB
case_studies.migration_from: Oracle Database Standard Edition on-premises VMs

quantified_outcomes.cost_savings_percent_autoscaling: 35% annual TCO savings vs on-premises VMs
quantified_outcomes.cost_savings_percent_elastic_pools: 49% annual TCO savings vs on-premises VMs
quantified_outcomes.hourly_fee_reduction: 76% lower hourly fees vs Standard Edition
quantified_outcomes.performance: Automated patching, tuning, security — zero DBA overhead

case_studies.summary: Oracle published reference TCO analysis for DB Standard Edition to ADB migration. Autoscaling option yields 35% TCO savings; Elastic Pools yield 49% savings. Hourly compute fees 76% lower. Used by Oracle SAs as directional benchmark.

case_studies.company: Generic: MySQL HeatWave vs Amazon Redshift

quantified_outcomes.performance: HeatWave outperforms Redshift on query benchmarks
quantified_outcomes.cost_comparison: Lower cost than Amazon Redshift for equivalent analytics workloads
quantified_outcomes.operational: No ETL required — analytics run in-place on OLTP data

case_studies.summary: Oracle published benchmark comparison showing MySQL HeatWave outperforms Amazon Redshift on price-performance for analytics. No ETL pipeline needed — HeatWave runs OLAP queries on same MySQL instance as OLTP.

quantified_outcomes.cost_comparison: HeatWave is ~1/8 the cost of Snowflake for equivalent analytics workloads

case_studies.summary: Oracle benchmark shows MySQL HeatWave is approximately one-eighth the cost of Snowflake for comparable analytics workloads, with no data movement or separate data warehouse required.

case_studies.company: Generic: MySQL HeatWave vs Amazon Aurora

quantified_outcomes.performance: HeatWave is 1,400x faster than Amazon Aurora for analytics queries

case_studies.summary: Oracle published benchmark demonstrating MySQL HeatWave performs analytics queries 1,400x faster than Amazon Aurora. Enables running analytics directly on MySQL without a separate data warehouse.

case_studies.company: Generic: OCI vs AWS Networking Cost Benchmark
case_studies.use_case_type: Cloud cost optimization / Migration from AWS

quantified_outcomes.networking_cost_savings: 80% savings on networking costs vs AWS
quantified_outcomes.compute_price_performance: 3x improvement in compute price-performance vs AWS (STAC-A2 benchmarks)
quantified_outcomes.hpc_compute_cost_reduction: 44% decrease in HPC compute costs vs AWS
quantified_outcomes.storage_cost: 82% less than AWS gp3 equivalent storage

case_studies.summary: Oracle published and independently validated benchmarks showing OCI delivers 80% networking savings, 3x compute price-performance improvement, 25% bandwidth cost reduction, and 82% lower storage costs vs AWS equivalents. STAC-A2 benchmarks validated for financial services Monte Carlo simulations.

quantified_outcomes.runtime_cost_reduction: Up to 90% reduction in migration runtime costs
quantified_outcomes.automation: ML-based automations for assessment and cutover planning

case_studies.summary: OCI Database Migration Service enables up to 90% runtime cost reduction vs manual migration approaches. Includes ML-based automations for assessment, schema conversion, and data transfer with minimal downtime.
